title: Cross-device digital keys and identity handoff in intelligent cockpits
topic: 智能座舱跨设备数字钥匙与身份切换
summary: 今天练习如何用英语描述数字钥匙在手机、手表、车机和共享账户之间流转时，智能座舱如何确认身份、保护隐私并平滑切换个性化设置。

words.meaning: 跨设备数字钥匙；可在手机、手表或其他可信设备上授权车辆访问的钥匙体验
words.example: A cross-device digital key should unlock the vehicle without hiding which device granted access.
words.chineseExample: 跨设备数字钥匙应能解锁车辆，同时不隐藏是哪个设备授予了访问权限。

words.meaning: 身份交接；系统在不同用户、设备或会话之间转移身份上下文的过程
words.example: Identity handoff helps the cockpit switch from a family profile to the driver profile before departure.
words.chineseExample: 身份交接帮助座舱在出发前从家庭档案切换到驾驶者档案。

words.meaning: 权限边界；清楚说明某个钥匙、账户或乘员可以控制哪些功能的限制
words.example: A permission boundary prevents a temporary guest key from changing payment or home address settings.
words.chineseExample: 权限边界可防止临时访客钥匙修改支付或家庭地址设置。

words.meaning: 档案仲裁；多个身份同时出现时判断应激活哪个个性化档案的规则
words.example: Profile arbitration is needed when the owner phone and a passenger watch enter the cabin together.
words.chineseExample: 当车主手机和乘客手表同时进入座舱时，需要档案仲裁。

words.meaning: 可信设备；已被授权用于身份识别、解锁或个性化加载的设备
words.example: The cockpit can show a trusted device list so users can remove an old phone safely.
words.chineseExample: 座舱可以显示可信设备列表，让用户安全移除旧手机。

words.meaning: 临时访问；在限定时间、地点或功能范围内授予他人的车辆使用权限
words.example: Temporary access should expire clearly and avoid exposing personal routes or contacts.
words.chineseExample: 临时访问应清楚过期，并避免暴露个人路线或联系人。

words.meaning: 隐私保护型解锁；完成解锁时最小化个人数据展示和共享的方案
words.example: Privacy-preserving unlock confirms access without displaying private calendar details on the center screen.
words.chineseExample: 隐私保护型解锁会确认访问权限，但不会在中控屏显示私人日历细节。

words.meaning: 账户恢复路径；设备丢失、钥匙失效或身份冲突时恢复访问的步骤
words.example: An account recovery path should guide users through verification without blocking urgent vehicle use.
words.chineseExample: 账户恢复路径应引导用户完成验证，同时不阻断紧急用车。

words.meaning: 共享座舱上下文；多人同车时系统需要理解的身份、座位和权限关系
words.example: Shared cabin context helps the interface separate driver settings from passenger entertainment choices.
words.chineseExample: 共享座舱上下文帮助界面区分驾驶者设置和乘客娱乐选择。

words.meaning: 撤销线索；提醒用户某个数字钥匙、设备或权限已被移除的界面提示
words.example: A revocation cue reassures the owner that a borrowed key no longer opens the vehicle.
words.chineseExample: 撤销线索让车主确认借出的钥匙已无法再打开车辆。

longReadings.title: Designing digital key handoff for shared vehicles
longReadings.text: A digital key is more than a convenient way to unlock a vehicle. In an intelligent cockpit, it becomes part of identity, privacy, and personalization. The difficult moment happens when several trusted devices arrive together: the owner phone is in the driver door pocket, a passenger watch is near the center console, and a temporary guest key is still valid from yesterday. The cockpit should not guess silently. It should show a calm identity handoff that explains which profile is active, which permissions are limited, and how the user can change the decision. Good profile arbitration protects both convenience and safety. Seat position, mirrors, payment settings, saved destinations, and voice history should not move to the wrong person simply because one device connected first. A privacy-preserving unlock also avoids showing private calendar events or home addresses before the driver identity is confirmed. When access is shared, the interface needs a visible permission boundary. A valet key may start the vehicle and open navigation, but it should not reveal messages or purchase services. If a phone is lost or a battery dies, an account recovery path must guide the user without creating panic. Digital key design is therefore not only about entry. It is about trust: users need to know who the car thinks they are, what the car will remember, and how quickly they can revoke or correct access.
longReadings.translation: 数字钥匙不只是便捷解锁车辆的方式。在智能座舱中，它会成为身份、隐私和个性化的一部分。真正困难的时刻发生在多个可信设备同时到达时：车主手机在驾驶门储物格里，乘客手表靠近中控台，而昨天的临时访客钥匙仍然有效。座舱不应静默猜测，而应显示平静的身份交接，说明当前激活的是哪个档案、哪些权限受限，以及用户如何改变这个决定。良好的档案仲裁会同时保护便利性和安全性。座椅位置、后视镜、支付设置、已保存目的地和语音历史，不应仅仅因为某个设备先连接就切换到错误的人。隐私保护型解锁也会避免在确认驾驶者身份前显示私人日历事件或家庭地址。当访问被共享时，界面需要可见的权限边界。代客钥匙可以启动车辆并打开导航，但不应暴露消息或购买服务。如果手机丢失或电池没电，账户恢复路径必须引导用户而不制造恐慌。因此，数字钥匙设计不只关于进入车辆，而是关于信任：用户需要知道车辆认为自己是谁、车辆会记住什么，以及他们能多快撤销或修正访问权限。

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: The cockpit should not guess silently.
sentenceBreakdowns.translation: 座舱不应静默猜测。
points: should not guess silently 用简短句强调身份判断必须可见、可解释。
silently 在这里不是声音问题，而是指系统不能在没有提示的情况下做决定。

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: Good profile arbitration protects both convenience and safety.
sentenceBreakdowns.translation: 良好的档案仲裁会同时保护便利性和安全性。
points: protects both A and B 是表达双重设计目标的常用结构。
profile arbitration 可用于讨论多人同车或多设备同时出现的冲突处理。

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: A valet key may start the vehicle and open navigation, but it should not reveal messages or purchase services.
sentenceBreakdowns.translation: 代客钥匙可以启动车辆并打开导航，但不应暴露消息或购买服务。
points: may..., but it should not... 用来区分允许能力和禁止能力。
reveal messages 与 purchase services 是隐私和交易风险的两个例子。

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: Users need to know who the car thinks they are, what the car will remember, and how quickly they can revoke or correct access.
sentenceBreakdowns.translation: 用户需要知道车辆认为自己是谁、车辆会记住什么，以及他们能多快撤销或修正访问权限。
points: who / what / how quickly 三个从句并列，适合总结信任设计。
revoke or correct access 表示撤销或修正权限，是数字钥匙场景中的高频表达。

practiceSteps.title: 词汇热身
practiceSteps.description: 朗读 cross-device digital key、identity handoff、permission boundary、profile arbitration，并用中文说明它们分别解决什么座舱问题。

practiceSteps.title: 长文跟读
practiceSteps.description: 跟读长文两遍，第二遍重点放慢 trusted devices、temporary guest key、privacy-preserving unlock 等多词短语。

practiceSteps.title: 句式替换
practiceSteps.description: 套用 “A valet key may..., but it should not...” 写 3 条临时权限说明，分别对应代客、家庭成员和维修人员。

practiceSteps.title: 交互说明练习
practiceSteps.description: 用英文设计一条身份交接提示，必须包含当前档案、受限权限、切换入口和撤销入口。

videos.title: Suggested search: automotive digital key UX identity handoff
videos.description: 可搜索 automotive digital key UX identity handoff，观察数字钥匙、账户切换和车辆共享权限的英文表达。

title: Connectivity fallback and degraded mode in intelligent cockpits
topic: 智能座舱连接中断备用交互与降级模式设计
summary: 今天练习如何用英语描述智能座舱在网络连接不稳定、云端服务不可用或地图刷新中断时，通过本地优先控制、清晰状态提示和可恢复路径保持服务连续性。

words.meaning: 连接中断时的备用交互；网络不可用时仍能完成关键任务的设计方案
words.example: Connectivity fallback keeps the navigation and climate controls usable when the vehicle loses its network connection.
words.chineseExample: 当车辆失去网络连接时，连接中断备用交互让导航和空调控制仍可使用。

words.meaning: 降级模式；部分在线能力不可用时保留核心功能的运行状态
words.example: A degraded mode should explain which connected services are limited and which controls still work locally.
words.chineseExample: 降级模式应说明哪些联网服务受限，以及哪些控制仍可在本地工作。

words.meaning: 离线意图处理；无网络时识别并执行本地可完成指令的能力
words.example: Offline intent handling lets the assistant adjust temperature even when cloud speech recognition is unavailable.
words.chineseExample: 即使云端语音识别不可用，离线意图处理也能让助手调节温度。

words.meaning: 服务连续性；系统在网络、账户或后端状态变化时保持体验不断裂
words.example: Service continuity is more important than a perfect online feature during a stressful drive.
words.chineseExample: 在压力较大的驾驶中，服务连续性比完美的在线功能更重要。

words.meaning: 本地优先控制；安全和常用功能优先由车端本地完成
words.example: Local-first control ensures that defrost, volume, and seat heating do not depend on a remote server.
words.chineseExample: 本地优先控制确保除雾、音量和座椅加热不依赖远程服务器。

words.meaning: 恢复可供性；提示用户如何重试、切换方式或等待服务恢复的界面线索
words.example: A recovery affordance can offer a retry button, a manual route, or a short reason for the delay.
words.chineseExample: 恢复可供性可以提供重试按钮、手动路径或延迟原因说明。

words.meaning: 网络状态线索；让驾驶者快速理解连接状态和影响范围的提示
words.example: A network status cue should be visible without forcing the driver to open a settings page.
words.chineseExample: 网络状态线索应无需驾驶者打开设置页就能被看到。

words.meaning: 优雅降级；系统能力下降时仍保持清晰、可控和安全的体验
words.example: Graceful degradation turns a failed cloud request into a clear local alternative.
words.chineseExample: 优雅降级会把失败的云端请求转化为清晰的本地替代方案。

words.meaning: 缓存指引；提前保存在本地、可在网络中断时继续使用的信息
words.example: Cached guidance can keep the next few turns available when map data stops refreshing.
words.chineseExample: 当地图数据停止刷新时，缓存指引可以保留接下来几个转向提示。

words.meaning: 交接提示；系统从在线能力切换到本地方案时给出的说明
words.example: The handover message should tell users what changed and what action remains available.
words.chineseExample: 交接提示应告诉用户发生了什么变化，以及还有哪些操作可用。

longReadings.title: Designing calm fallback when connectivity drops
longReadings.text: An intelligent cockpit should not feel helpless when connectivity drops. Drivers still need route guidance, climate controls, media volume, defrost, and basic assistant commands, even if a cloud service is slow or unavailable. A good degraded mode begins with local-first control. Safety-critical and frequently used vehicle functions should remain on the vehicle, while online features can pause with a short explanation. The interface should show a visible network status cue, but it should not blame the driver or interrupt the road view with a large warning. The best handover message is specific: voice search is offline, but temperature, defrost, and cached guidance still work. Offline intent handling also needs careful wording. If the assistant cannot answer a restaurant search, it can offer saved destinations or manual typing instead of saying only that the request failed. This is graceful degradation: the system admits a temporary limitation, keeps the core task moving, and gives the user a recovery affordance. Designers should test these moments in tunnels, parking garages, rural roads, and weak cellular areas. Connectivity fallback is not a technical afterthought. It is a trust signal that tells drivers the cockpit understands real driving conditions and can keep useful control available under pressure.
longReadings.translation: 当连接中断时，智能座舱不应显得无能为力。即使云端服务缓慢或不可用，驾驶者仍然需要路线指引、空调控制、媒体音量、除雾和基础助手指令。好的降级模式从本地优先控制开始。安全关键和高频使用的车辆功能应保留在车端，而在线功能可以暂停，并给出简短解释。界面应显示可见的网络状态线索，但不应责怪驾驶者，也不应用大警告遮挡道路视图。最好的交接提示是具体的：语音搜索离线，但温度、除雾和缓存指引仍然可用。离线意图处理也需要谨慎措辞。如果助手无法回答餐厅搜索，它可以提供已保存目的地或手动输入，而不是只说请求失败。这就是优雅降级：系统承认临时限制，保持核心任务推进，并给用户恢复可供性。设计师应在隧道、停车库、乡村道路和弱蜂窝信号区域测试这些时刻。连接中断备用交互不是技术上的事后补救，而是一种信任信号，告诉驾驶者座舱理解真实驾驶条件，并能在压力下保持有用控制。

practiceSteps.title: 词汇热身
practiceSteps.description: 朗读 connectivity fallback、degraded mode、local-first control、graceful degradation，并用中文解释每个短语适合出现在哪类座舱故障场景。

practiceSteps.title: 场景复述
practiceSteps.description: 用英文复述长文中的连接中断场景，必须包含 network status cue、handover message 和 recovery affordance。

practiceSteps.title: 句式替换
practiceSteps.description: 套用 “The best handover message is specific: ... still work.” 写 3 条降级模式提示文案。

practiceSteps.title: 交互设计练习
practiceSteps.description: 设计一个 weak cellular area 中的语音助手失败提示，要求说明限制、保留可用功能，并提供一个手动恢复路径。

title: Consent-based voice profiles and shared cabin privacy
topic: 智能座舱基于同意的声纹档案与共享座舱隐私
summary: 今天练习如何用英语描述智能座舱在识别说话人、切换个人配置和处理共享乘坐场景时，明确征得同意、限制数据使用并保护乘员隐私。

words.meaning: 基于同意的声纹档案；只有在用户明确允许后才创建或使用的声音识别配置
words.example: A consent-based voice profile should be created only after the driver understands what data will be stored.
words.chineseExample: 基于同意的声纹档案只应在驾驶者理解将保存哪些数据后创建。

words.meaning: 共享座舱隐私；多名乘员共处车内时对个人数据、语音和偏好的保护
words.example: Shared cabin privacy matters when one passenger asks the assistant to read a private message aloud.
words.chineseExample: 当一名乘员要求助手朗读私人消息时，共享座舱隐私就很重要。

words.meaning: 说话人识别；判断当前语音来自哪位用户的能力
words.example: Speaker recognition can personalize settings, but it must avoid exposing another occupant's account.
words.chineseExample: 说话人识别可以个性化设置，但必须避免暴露另一位乘员的账户。

words.meaning: 明确同意；用户清楚理解并主动确认的数据授权
words.example: Explicit consent is stronger than a vague notice hidden inside a general setup screen.
words.chineseExample: 明确同意比隐藏在通用设置页里的模糊提示更有约束力。

words.meaning: 注册流程；创建声纹或个人档案时的步骤和说明
words.example: The enrollment flow should explain how to pause, delete, or retrain a voice profile.
words.chineseExample: 注册流程应说明如何暂停、删除或重新训练声纹档案。

words.meaning: 隐私边界；系统在个性化、朗读和数据共享时不能越过的界限
words.example: A clear privacy boundary prevents the assistant from reading a message to the wrong person.
words.chineseExample: 清晰的隐私边界可防止助手把消息读给错误的人。

words.meaning: 身份交接；系统在驾驶者或主要说话人改变时切换个人身份上下文
words.example: Identity handoff should ask for confirmation before applying another person's seat and media preferences.
words.chineseExample: 身份交接在应用另一人的座椅和媒体偏好前应请求确认。

words.meaning: 数据最小化；只收集实现功能所必需的数据
words.example: Data minimization means the cockpit stores a voice template, not every raw command recording.
words.chineseExample: 数据最小化意味着座舱保存声纹模板，而不是每条原始指令录音。

words.meaning: 乘员感知提示；根据车内不同乘员身份和位置调整的提示
words.example: An occupant-aware prompt can ask whether a message should stay on screen or move to headphones.
words.chineseExample: 乘员感知提示可以询问信息应留在屏幕上还是转到耳机中。

words.meaning: 撤销控制；让用户随时撤回授权或删除相关配置的控制项
words.example: Revocation control must be easy to find after the initial setup is complete.
words.chineseExample: 初始设置完成后，撤销控制也必须容易找到。

longReadings.title: Designing voice profiles for shared cabins
longReadings.text: Voice profiles can make an intelligent cockpit feel fast and personal, but they also create a privacy problem in shared cabins. A car may recognize the driver, a front passenger, and a rear passenger during the same trip. If the assistant chooses the wrong identity, it might read a private message aloud, expose a calendar detail, or apply another person's media and seat preferences. A consent-based design starts with a clear enrollment flow. The system should say what will be stored, whether the voice template stays local or moves to the cloud, how long it will be retained, and how the profile owner can pause, delete, or retrain it. During use, the cockpit should show the active profile and ask a short confirmation question when speaker recognition is uncertain. For guests, borrowed vehicles, and ride-share situations, a temporary guest mode is often safer than silent personalization. The goal is not to remove personalization; it is to keep personalization inside a visible privacy boundary. Good prompts sound simple: “I think this message belongs to Li. Should I keep it private?” That small question protects trust better than a hidden setting.
longReadings.translation: 声纹档案可以让智能座舱感觉更快速、更个性化，但在共享座舱中也会产生隐私问题。同一次行程中，车辆可能识别驾驶者、前排乘员和后排乘员。如果助手选择了错误身份，它可能会朗读私人消息、暴露日历细节，或应用另一个人的媒体和座椅偏好。基于同意的设计从清晰的注册流程开始。系统应说明将保存什么、声纹模板是保留在本地还是传到云端、保留多久，以及档案所有者如何暂停、删除或重新训练它。在使用过程中，座舱应显示当前档案，并在说话人识别不确定时提出简短确认问题。对于访客、借用车辆和拼车场景，临时访客模式通常比静默个性化更安全。目标不是移除个性化，而是把个性化保持在可见的隐私边界内。好的提示听起来很简单：“我认为这条消息属于 Li。要为你保密吗？”这个小问题比隐藏设置更能保护信任。

title: Context-aware quiet mode and recoverable prompts in intelligent cockpits
topic: 智能座舱情境感知静音模式与可恢复提示
summary: 今天练习如何用英语描述智能座舱在电话、儿童乘员、学校区域或高驾驶负荷下，临时降低提示打扰，并用可恢复的方式保留重要信息。

words.meaning: 情境感知静音模式；系统根据驾驶、乘员和环境状态临时降低提示打扰
words.example: Context-aware quiet mode reduces non-urgent prompts when the driver is taking a phone call.
words.chineseExample: 当驾驶者正在接电话时，情境感知静音模式会减少非紧急提示。

words.meaning: 可恢复提示；被暂缓或静音后仍能被用户找回的提示
words.example: A recoverable prompt moves a low-priority reminder into a later review tray instead of deleting it.
words.chineseExample: 可恢复提示会把低优先级提醒移入稍后查看区，而不是直接删除。

words.meaning: 打扰预算；在特定驾驶场景中允许系统占用用户注意力的限度
words.example: The interruption budget should shrink during complex merges, school zones, and voice calls.
words.chineseExample: 在复杂并线、学校区域和语音通话中，打扰预算应缩小。

words.meaning: 延后通知；被系统推迟到更合适时机展示的通知
words.example: A deferred notification should explain why it was held back and when it became visible again.
words.chineseExample: 延后通知应说明它为何被暂缓，以及何时重新可见。

words.meaning: 注意力窗口；用户适合接收、判断或操作信息的短时间段
words.example: The assistant waits for a safer attention window before showing a subscription renewal message.
words.chineseExample: 助手会等待更安全的注意力窗口，再展示订阅续费信息。

words.meaning: 静音状态回执；说明哪些提示被静音、保留或稍后恢复的简短反馈
words.example: A quiet-state receipt helps the driver trust that important alerts were not lost.
words.chineseExample: 静音状态回执帮助驾驶者相信重要警报没有丢失。

words.meaning: 优先级降级；在高负荷情境中降低非关键提示的展示强度
words.example: Priority downgrade changes a visual pop-up into a small status icon during a busy junction.
words.chineseExample: 在繁忙路口，优先级降级会把视觉弹窗改成小状态图标。

words.meaning: 恢复提示线索；帮助用户稍后继续查看被延后信息的提示
words.example: A resumption cue should appear after the call ends, not during the most demanding maneuver.
words.chineseExample: 恢复提示线索应在通话结束后出现，而不是在最高负荷操作期间出现。

words.meaning: 抑制规则；决定何时静音、延后或降级提示的系统规则
words.example: Each suppression rule needs a clear exception for safety-critical warnings.
words.chineseExample: 每条抑制规则都需要为安全关键警告设置清晰例外。

words.meaning: 用户可见逻辑；让用户理解系统为什么静音或恢复某条提示的说明
words.example: User-visible logic turns quiet mode from a mystery into an understandable design decision.
words.chineseExample: 用户可见逻辑会把静音模式从谜团变成可理解的设计决策。

longReadings.title: Designing quiet mode without hiding information
longReadings.text: In an intelligent cockpit, quiet mode should not simply silence the interface. A better design uses context signals such as traffic density, location context, cabin audio, an active phone call, and driver workload to decide which prompts can wait. For example, a charging offer or subscription renewal message can move into a review tray during a complex merge, while a seat belt alert or rear-seat reminder must still break through. The key is to make suppression recoverable and explainable. When the system defers a non-urgent prompt, it should preserve the message, show a subtle status icon, and provide a quiet-state receipt later. That receipt can say, “Three comfort reminders were held back during your call.” After the call ends or the route becomes calmer, a resumption cue can invite the driver to review the delayed prompts. This pattern protects attention without creating the fear that information disappeared. It also gives designers a useful language for risk tiers: suppress marketing, downgrade comfort, defer navigation updates when safe, and always override quiet mode for safety-critical warnings.
longReadings.translation: 在智能座舱中，静音模式不应只是让界面沉默。更好的设计会利用交通密度、位置情境、座舱音频、进行中的电话和驾驶负荷等情境信号，判断哪些提示可以等待。例如，在复杂并线时，充电优惠或订阅续费信息可以进入稍后查看区，而安全带警报或后排提醒必须仍然突破静音。关键是让抑制可恢复、可解释。当系统延后非紧急提示时，应保留消息、显示细微状态图标，并在稍后提供静音状态回执。回执可以说：“通话期间已暂缓 3 条舒适提醒。”通话结束或路线变得更平稳后，恢复提示线索可以邀请驾驶者查看延后提示。这种模式保护注意力，同时避免用户担心信息消失。它也为设计师提供了风险层级语言：抑制营销、降级舒适提示、在安全时延后导航更新，并始终让安全关键警告覆盖静音模式。

title: Transparent automation and user veto design in intelligent cockpits
topic: 智能座舱透明自动化与用户否决权设计
summary: 今天练习如何用英语描述智能座舱在自动调节、路线变更或隐私相关动作前，清楚说明意图、范围、倒计时和用户否决入口，让自动化既高效又可控。

words.example: Transparent automation tells the driver what will change, why it will change, and how to stop it.
words.chineseExample: 透明自动化会告诉驾驶者什么将改变、为什么改变，以及如何停止。

words.meaning: 用户否决权；用户快速阻止、取消或覆盖系统自动动作的能力
words.example: A user veto is meaningful only when the cancel action is visible before the automation starts.
words.chineseExample: 只有在自动化开始前取消动作可见，用户否决权才有意义。

words.meaning: 执行前预览；自动动作执行前展示将发生的具体变化
words.example: The pre-action preview should name the cabin mode, affected settings, and remaining countdown window.
words.chineseExample: 执行前预览应说明座舱模式、受影响设置和剩余倒计时窗口。

words.meaning: 范围边界；明确自动化会影响和不会影响哪些功能
words.example: A scope boundary prevents a comfort suggestion from sounding like a full vehicle takeover.
words.chineseExample: 范围边界能避免舒适建议听起来像完整车辆接管。

words.meaning: 低扫视否决；驾驶中无需长时间看屏即可完成的否决动作
words.example: A glance-safe veto uses a stable cancel target, short wording, and optional voice control.
words.chineseExample: 低扫视否决使用稳定取消目标、短措辞和可选语音控制。

words.meaning: 自动化回执；动作完成后说明系统做了什么并提供撤销入口
words.example: An automation receipt helps the driver review a cabin change without opening a settings menu.
words.chineseExample: 自动化回执帮助驾驶者无需打开设置菜单也能查看座舱变化。

words.meaning: 同意检查点；执行敏感或高影响动作前的确认环节
words.example: A consent checkpoint is required when automation touches identity, payment, or location sharing.
words.chineseExample: 当自动化涉及身份、支付或位置共享时，需要同意检查点。

words.meaning: 确认负担；频繁确认给用户带来的认知和操作成本
words.example: Designers should reduce confirmation burden for low-risk comfort actions but keep strong consent for high-risk actions.
words.chineseExample: 设计师应降低低风险舒适动作的确认负担，但保留高风险动作的强同意。

words.meaning: 手动回退；自动化失败、取消或被拒绝后回到用户手动控制
words.example: Manual fallback reassures the driver that automation is helpful, not compulsory.
words.chineseExample: 手动回退让驾驶者相信自动化是帮助性的，而不是强制性的。

words.meaning: 自动化惊讶感；系统突然动作导致用户困惑或不适
words.example: Automation surprise usually means the system hid its intent until it was too late to intervene.
words.chineseExample: 自动化惊讶感通常意味着系统隐藏意图，直到用户来不及介入。

glossary.meaning: 透明自动化；系统清楚说明将要自动执行什么以及为什么
glossary.example: Transparent automation shows the planned action before the cabin changes state.
glossary.chineseExample: 透明自动化会在座舱改变状态前展示计划动作。

glossary.meaning: 用户否决权；用户可快速阻止、取消或覆盖系统自动动作的能力
glossary.example: A clear user veto keeps automation from feeling forced.
glossary.chineseExample: 清晰的用户否决权能避免自动化显得强迫。

glossary.meaning: 自动化意图；系统准备执行某个动作的目的或理由
glossary.example: The automation intent should be visible before the assistant acts.
glossary.chineseExample: 助手行动前，应让自动化意图可见。

glossary.meaning: 范围边界；自动化动作可以影响哪些功能、不可影响哪些功能
glossary.example: A scope boundary tells the driver which settings will remain unchanged.
glossary.chineseExample: 范围边界告诉驾驶者哪些设置不会改变。

glossary.meaning: 否决可供性；让用户一眼看到并易于触发的取消或阻止入口
glossary.example: The veto affordance must be reachable without a long visual search.
glossary.chineseExample: 否决可供性必须无需长时间视觉搜索即可触达。

glossary.meaning: 长按取消控件；通过持续按压防止误触的取消方式
glossary.example: A hold-to-cancel control can protect critical actions from accidental taps.
glossary.chineseExample: 长按取消控件可以防止关键动作被误触取消。

glossary.meaning: 执行前预览；在系统执行前展示即将改变的内容
glossary.example: A pre-action preview gives users time to correct a wrong assumption.
glossary.chineseExample: 执行前预览让用户有时间纠正错误假设。

glossary.meaning: 倒计时窗口；自动动作执行前留给用户反应的短时间段
glossary.example: The countdown window should match the urgency of the driving context.
glossary.chineseExample: 倒计时窗口应匹配驾驶场景的紧急程度。

glossary.meaning: 覆盖路径；用户接管或改写系统动作的流程
glossary.example: The override path should remain simple when the vehicle is moving.
glossary.chineseExample: 车辆行驶时，覆盖路径应保持简单。

glossary.meaning: 手动回退；自动化失败或被拒绝后回到用户手动控制
glossary.example: Manual fallback reassures drivers that they are still in control.
glossary.chineseExample: 手动回退让驾驶者相信自己仍掌控局面。

glossary.meaning: 可解释自动化；自动行为能用简洁语言说明理由
glossary.example: Explainable automation builds trust only when the reason is specific.
glossary.chineseExample: 只有理由具体时，可解释自动化才会建立信任。

glossary.meaning: 驾驶者主导权；驾驶者对车辆和座舱关键动作的最终控制权
glossary.example: Driver authority is preserved when the system asks before changing a safety-related setting.
glossary.chineseExample: 系统在改变安全相关设置前询问，可以保留驾驶者主导权。

glossary.meaning: 同意检查点；执行敏感或高影响动作前的确认环节
glossary.example: A consent checkpoint is useful before sharing location or changing payment details.
glossary.chineseExample: 在共享位置或更改支付信息前，同意检查点很有用。

glossary.meaning: 静默自动化；系统在不明显提示用户的情况下自动执行
glossary.example: Silent automation is risky when the action affects comfort, privacy, or safety.
glossary.chineseExample: 当动作影响舒适、隐私或安全时，静默自动化有风险。

glossary.meaning: 状态横幅；用短文本显示自动化当前状态的界面区域
glossary.example: A status banner can say that seat ventilation will start in ten seconds.
glossary.chineseExample: 状态横幅可以说明座椅通风将在十秒后启动。

glossary.meaning: 可中断流程；用户可在过程中暂停、取消或修改的交互流程
glossary.example: An interruptible flow lets the driver stop automation without losing the destination.
glossary.chineseExample: 可中断流程让驾驶者停止自动化而不丢失目的地。

glossary.meaning: 可撤销自动化；执行后仍能恢复到先前状态的自动动作
glossary.example: Reversible automation is easier to accept than a one-way decision.
glossary.chineseExample: 可撤销自动化比单向决定更容易被接受。

glossary.meaning: 确认负担；系统要求用户确认造成的认知和操作成本
glossary.example: Too many prompts increase confirmation burden and reduce trust.
glossary.chineseExample: 过多提示会增加确认负担并降低信任。

glossary.meaning: 低扫视否决；驾驶中无需长时间看屏即可完成的否决动作
glossary.example: A glance-safe veto uses large targets and plain wording.
glossary.chineseExample: 低扫视否决使用大触控目标和清晰措辞。

glossary.meaning: 自动化回执；动作完成后说明系统做了什么和如何撤销
glossary.example: An automation receipt should include a short undo option.
glossary.chineseExample: 自动化回执应包含简短的撤销选项。

glossary.meaning: 意图横幅；显示系统即将执行动作及原因的提示条
glossary.example: The intent banner should separate the reason from the command.
glossary.chineseExample: 意图横幅应把理由和命令分开。

glossary.meaning: 驾驶者否决；驾驶者阻止系统建议或自动动作
glossary.example: Driver veto must work even when the assistant believes its choice is optimal.
glossary.chineseExample: 即使助手认为选择最优，驾驶者否决也必须有效。

glossary.meaning: 自动化透明度；用户理解系统状态、依据和后果的程度
glossary.example: Automation transparency reduces surprise during cabin adjustments.
glossary.chineseExample: 自动化透明度减少座舱调节中的意外感。

glossary.meaning: 动作预览；展示将发生的具体变化
glossary.example: The action preview names the exact setting and target value.
glossary.chineseExample: 动作预览会说明确切设置和目标值。

glossary.meaning: 取消目标；用于停止动作的可点击或可说控件
glossary.example: The cancel target should be visually stable during the countdown.
glossary.chineseExample: 倒计时时，取消目标应视觉稳定。

glossary.meaning: 语音否决；通过语音命令阻止系统动作
glossary.example: A voice veto such as 'stop that' should map to the current automation.
glossary.chineseExample: “停止这个”等语音否决应映射到当前自动化。

glossary.meaning: 手势否决；通过手势取消或拒绝系统动作
glossary.example: A gesture veto can help when speech recognition is unreliable.
glossary.chineseExample: 当语音识别不可靠时，手势否决很有帮助。

glossary.meaning: 触控否决；通过屏幕或物理按键取消动作
glossary.example: A touch veto needs a large hit area in a moving vehicle.
glossary.chineseExample: 移动车辆中的触控否决需要较大的点击区域。

glossary.meaning: 回退状态；取消或失败后系统返回的安全状态
glossary.example: The fallback state should be predictable and easy to explain.
glossary.chineseExample: 回退状态应可预测且易解释。

glossary.meaning: 决策窗口；用户可接受、拒绝或修改建议的时间
glossary.example: The decision window becomes shorter when the event is urgent.
glossary.chineseExample: 事件越紧急，决策窗口越短。

glossary.meaning: 自动化队列；系统等待执行的一组自动动作
glossary.example: The automation queue should not hide high-impact changes.
glossary.chineseExample: 自动化队列不应隐藏高影响改变。

glossary.meaning: 高影响动作；会显著影响安全、隐私、路线或费用的动作
glossary.example: A high-impact action requires stronger confirmation than a comfort tweak.
glossary.chineseExample: 高影响动作比舒适微调需要更强确认。

glossary.meaning: 舒适微调；对温度、通风、座椅等舒适功能的小幅调整
glossary.example: A comfort tweak can use a lightweight preview instead of a modal dialog.
glossary.chineseExample: 舒适微调可使用轻量预览，而不是模态弹窗。

glossary.meaning: 模态提示；需要用户处理后才能继续的强打断提示
glossary.example: A modal prompt should be reserved for decisions that cannot wait.
glossary.chineseExample: 模态提示应保留给不能等待的决定。

glossary.meaning: 环境式提示；用灯光、声音或轻量视觉状态提示用户
glossary.example: An ambient prompt can announce automation without stealing attention.
glossary.chineseExample: 环境式提示可以告知自动化而不夺走注意力。

glossary.meaning: 注意力成本；理解或处理提示需要占用的注意力资源
glossary.example: The attention cost of a veto should be lower than the cost of fixing the result.
glossary.chineseExample: 否决的注意力成本应低于事后修正结果的成本。

glossary.meaning: 驾驶情境；速度、道路、交通和驾驶负荷等实时条件
glossary.example: The driving context determines whether the system should wait or act.
glossary.chineseExample: 驾驶情境决定系统应等待还是行动。

glossary.meaning: 道路复杂度；交叉口、车道、交通参与者等造成的场景难度
glossary.example: High road complexity calls for shorter messages and fewer choices.
glossary.chineseExample: 高道路复杂度需要更短信息和更少选择。

glossary.meaning: 用户能动性；用户理解、决定并改变系统行为的能力
glossary.example: User agency increases when automation has a visible exit.
glossary.chineseExample: 当自动化有可见退出口时，用户能动性会增强。

glossary.meaning: 系统主动性；系统先提出或执行动作的程度
glossary.example: System initiative should rise only when the benefit is clear.
glossary.chineseExample: 只有收益明确时，系统主动性才应提高。

glossary.meaning: 情境触发器；使自动化开始的条件或事件
glossary.example: A context trigger can be rain, low battery, or repeated cabin behavior.
glossary.chineseExample: 情境触发器可以是下雨、低电量或重复的座舱行为。

glossary.meaning: 自动化理由；解释系统为什么建议或执行动作的简短依据
glossary.example: The automation rationale should mention the trigger and expected benefit.
glossary.chineseExample: 自动化理由应说明触发条件和预期收益。

glossary.meaning: 预期收益；自动动作希望带来的安全、舒适或效率改善
glossary.example: The expected benefit must be concrete enough for a driver to judge.
glossary.chineseExample: 预期收益必须足够具体，便于驾驶者判断。

glossary.meaning: 可能缺点；自动动作可能带来的不便、风险或误判
glossary.example: A possible downside helps users make an informed veto decision.
glossary.chineseExample: 可能缺点帮助用户做出知情否决决定。

glossary.meaning: 撤销选项；执行后快速恢复前一状态的入口
glossary.example: The undo option should stay available long enough to notice the outcome.
glossary.chineseExample: 撤销选项应保留足够长时间，让用户看到结果。

glossary.meaning: 状态变化；系统设置、模式或任务进度的改变
glossary.example: Every visible state change should have a plain-language label.
glossary.chineseExample: 每个可见状态变化都应有通俗标签。

glossary.meaning: 座舱模式；座舱在驾驶、休息、娱乐等场景下的组合状态
glossary.example: Cabin mode changes should be previewed before lighting and seat settings move together.
glossary.chineseExample: 灯光和座椅设置联动前，应预览座舱模式变化。

glossary.meaning: 座椅通风；通过座椅空气流动改善舒适性的功能
glossary.example: Seat ventilation is a low-risk automation when the user can stop it quickly.
glossary.chineseExample: 如果用户能快速停止，座椅通风属于低风险自动化。

glossary.meaning: 空调调节；改变温度、风量或出风模式的动作
glossary.example: A climate adjustment can be automated after repeated manual corrections.
glossary.chineseExample: 多次手动修正后，可以自动化空调调节。

glossary.meaning: 路线变更；导航路径发生改变
glossary.example: A route change needs a stronger preview than a climate adjustment.
glossary.chineseExample: 路线变更比空调调节需要更强预览。

glossary.meaning: 隐私敏感动作；涉及位置、身份、联系人或个人习惯的动作
glossary.example: A privacy-sensitive action should never be silent.
glossary.chineseExample: 隐私敏感动作绝不应静默执行。

glossary.meaning: 安全相关设置；可能影响驾驶安全或法规合规的功能设置
glossary.example: A safety-related setting requires clear authority and traceable confirmation.
glossary.chineseExample: 安全相关设置需要清晰权限和可追踪确认。

glossary.meaning: 可追踪确认；可在记录中说明谁确认了什么动作
glossary.example: Traceable confirmation matters for payment and shared vehicle scenarios.
glossary.chineseExample: 可追踪确认对支付和共享车辆场景很重要。

glossary.meaning: 共享车辆；由多个用户或家庭成员共同使用的车辆
glossary.example: A shared vehicle needs visible profile and consent boundaries.
glossary.chineseExample: 共享车辆需要可见的账号和同意边界。

glossary.meaning: 档案边界；不同用户偏好和权限之间的分隔
glossary.example: A profile boundary prevents one driver's automation from surprising another driver.
glossary.chineseExample: 档案边界防止一个驾驶者的自动化设置影响另一个驾驶者。

glossary.meaning: 权限范围；用户授权系统可访问或改变的内容范围
glossary.example: Permission scope should be shown before automation uses personal data.
glossary.chineseExample: 自动化使用个人数据前应展示权限范围。

glossary.meaning: 敏感数据；身份、位置、支付或生物识别等需保护的数据
glossary.example: Sensitive data requires a stronger consent checkpoint.
glossary.chineseExample: 敏感数据需要更强的同意检查点。

glossary.meaning: 事件日志；记录系统动作、触发条件和用户选择的列表
glossary.example: An event log helps explain why the cabin changed mode.
glossary.chineseExample: 事件日志有助于解释座舱为何改变模式。

glossary.meaning: 清晰措辞；避免技术黑话、便于快速理解的文字
glossary.example: Plain wording is essential in a moving cockpit.
glossary.chineseExample: 清晰措辞在移动座舱中至关重要。

glossary.meaning: 短标签；用几个词概括动作或状态的界面文字
glossary.example: A short label should name the action, not the algorithm.
glossary.chineseExample: 短标签应命名动作，而不是命名算法。

glossary.meaning: 具体原因；可验证、与当前情境直接相关的解释
glossary.example: A specific reason is better than saying the system optimized the experience.
glossary.chineseExample: 具体原因比说系统优化了体验更好。

glossary.meaning: 当前自动化；正在准备、倒计时或执行中的系统动作
glossary.example: The current automation should be easy to identify before a voice veto.
glossary.chineseExample: 语音否决前，应容易识别当前自动化。

glossary.meaning: 用户修正；用户对系统假设、建议或动作的修改
glossary.example: User correction should update future automation cautiously.
glossary.chineseExample: 用户修正应谨慎地更新未来自动化。

glossary.meaning: 未来自动化；之后可能由系统主动执行的动作
glossary.example: Future automation should remember the rule only with user consent.
glossary.chineseExample: 未来自动化只有在用户同意后才应记住规则。

glossary.meaning: 学习规则；系统从用户行为中形成的自动化条件
glossary.example: A learning rule should be editable and easy to delete.
glossary.chineseExample: 学习规则应可编辑且易删除。

glossary.meaning: 可编辑规则；用户能查看并修改的自动化规则
glossary.example: An editable rule makes personalization feel controllable.
glossary.chineseExample: 可编辑规则让个性化更可控。

glossary.meaning: 删除规则；移除自动化学习结果的操作
glossary.example: A delete rule option matters when a borrowed car learns the wrong habit.
glossary.chineseExample: 当借用车辆学习了错误习惯时，删除规则选项很重要。

glossary.meaning: 借用车辆；临时由非主要用户驾驶的车辆
glossary.example: A borrowed car should ask before saving a new automation preference.
glossary.chineseExample: 借用车辆在保存新自动化偏好前应询问。

glossary.meaning: 家庭账号；多个家庭成员共享车辆服务的账号结构
glossary.example: A family account needs clear ownership of automation rules.
glossary.chineseExample: 家庭账号需要清楚说明自动化规则归属。

glossary.meaning: 归属提示；说明某个规则、设置或数据属于谁的提示
glossary.example: An ownership cue can prevent confusion in family vehicles.
glossary.chineseExample: 归属提示可以防止家庭车辆中的混淆。

glossary.meaning: 关键时刻；驾驶任务负荷较高或风险较高的瞬间
glossary.example: At a critical moment, automation should reduce choices instead of adding them.
glossary.chineseExample: 在关键时刻，自动化应减少选择，而不是增加选择。

glossary.meaning: 视觉层级；通过大小、位置和对比组织信息优先级
glossary.example: Visual hierarchy should make the veto more visible than secondary details.
glossary.chineseExample: 视觉层级应让否决入口比次要细节更明显。

glossary.meaning: 次要细节；当前不必立即处理的补充信息
glossary.example: Secondary detail can wait until the vehicle is stopped.
glossary.chineseExample: 次要细节可以等车辆停止后再显示。

glossary.meaning: 安全护栏；防止系统或用户操作造成风险的限制
glossary.example: A safety guardrail may block automation during complex maneuvers.
glossary.chineseExample: 安全护栏可能会在复杂操作中阻止自动化。

glossary.meaning: 复杂操作；并线、转弯、泊车等需要高注意力的驾驶动作
glossary.example: A complex maneuver is a poor time for a long confirmation prompt.
glossary.chineseExample: 复杂操作时不适合出现长确认提示。

glossary.meaning: 最小提示；只包含必要动作、原因和选择的提示
glossary.example: A minimal prompt can reduce attention cost.
glossary.chineseExample: 最小提示可以降低注意力成本。

glossary.meaning: 自动化惊讶感；用户对系统突然动作产生的不适或困惑
glossary.example: Automation surprise often means the preview arrived too late.
glossary.chineseExample: 自动化惊讶感通常意味着预览出现得太晚。

glossary.meaning: 过晚预览；在用户几乎无法反应时才提示即将执行的动作
glossary.example: A late preview weakens the value of the veto.
glossary.chineseExample: 过晚预览会削弱否决权的价值。

glossary.meaning: 提前预览；在执行前足够早提示系统动作
glossary.example: An early preview gives the user a realistic chance to intervene.
glossary.chineseExample: 提前预览给用户真实介入机会。

glossary.meaning: 介入；用户打断、修改或接管系统动作
glossary.example: Drivers should be able to intervene without hunting through menus.
glossary.chineseExample: 驾驶者应能介入，而不必在菜单中寻找入口。

glossary.meaning: 费力寻找；为了找到控件而在界面中反复搜索
glossary.example: Hunting for a cancel control is unsafe while driving.
glossary.chineseExample: 驾驶中费力寻找取消控件是不安全的。

glossary.meaning: 通俗语言标签；不用专业术语描述状态或动作的标签
glossary.example: A plain-language label can say 'Cooling seat soon' instead of a technical rule name.
glossary.chineseExample: 通俗语言标签可以写“即将开启座椅降温”，而不是技术规则名。

glossary.meaning: 安全默认值；在不确定或无回应时采用的保守选择
glossary.example: A safe default should avoid high-impact changes.
glossary.chineseExample: 安全默认值应避免高影响改变。

glossary.meaning: 无回应；用户没有在决策窗口内做出选择
glossary.example: No response should not be treated as consent for sensitive actions.
glossary.chineseExample: 对敏感动作而言，无回应不应视为同意。

glossary.meaning: 明确同意；用户清楚表达允许系统执行动作
glossary.example: Explicit consent is necessary for payment, sharing, or identity actions.
glossary.chineseExample: 支付、共享或身份动作需要明确同意。

glossary.meaning: 默示同意；系统根据行为推断用户同意
glossary.example: Implicit consent is acceptable only for low-risk comfort actions.
glossary.chineseExample: 默示同意只适合低风险舒适动作。

glossary.meaning: 低风险动作；容易撤销且影响较小的动作
glossary.example: A low-risk action can use a smaller prompt.
glossary.chineseExample: 低风险动作可使用更轻量提示。

glossary.meaning: 高风险动作；难撤销或可能影响安全、隐私、费用的动作
glossary.example: A high-risk action needs explicit consent.
glossary.chineseExample: 高风险动作需要明确同意。

glossary.meaning: 驾驶者负荷；驾驶者当前承受的信息、操作和注意压力
glossary.example: Driver workload should shape how much automation detail appears.
glossary.chineseExample: 驾驶者负荷应影响自动化细节的展示量。

glossary.meaning: 信息密度；单位界面区域内的信息量
glossary.example: Information density should drop when workload rises.
glossary.chineseExample: 负荷上升时，信息密度应下降。

glossary.meaning: 进度指示器；显示自动化准备、倒计时或完成进度的控件
glossary.example: A progress indicator helps users understand how much time remains.
glossary.chineseExample: 进度指示器帮助用户理解剩余时间。

glossary.meaning: 完成消息；动作完成后展示的简短状态说明
glossary.example: A completion message should include the new state and undo option.
glossary.chineseExample: 完成消息应包含新状态和撤销选项。

glossary.meaning: 信任校准；让用户对系统能力和限制形成准确预期
glossary.example: Trust calibration depends on clear limits as much as clear benefits.
glossary.chineseExample: 信任校准既依赖清晰收益，也依赖清晰限制。

glossary.meaning: 能力限制；系统无法可靠完成或判断的边界
glossary.example: A capability limit should be stated before automation becomes risky.
glossary.chineseExample: 在自动化变得有风险前，应说明能力限制。

glossary.meaning: 自动化策略；决定系统何时建议、等待或执行的规则
glossary.example: An automation policy should be understandable to non-expert users.
glossary.chineseExample: 自动化策略应能被非专业用户理解。

glossary.meaning: 非专业用户；不具备专业背景的普通用户
glossary.example: A non-expert user needs outcome-focused wording.
glossary.chineseExample: 非专业用户需要以结果为中心的措辞。

glossary.meaning: 结果导向措辞；直接说明用户会看到或感受到什么变化
glossary.example: Outcome-focused wording is better than naming internal models.
glossary.chineseExample: 结果导向措辞比命名内部模型更好。

glossary.meaning: 内部模型；系统内部用于预测或决策的算法模型
glossary.example: The internal model can stay hidden if the user sees the practical result.
glossary.chineseExample: 如果用户看到实际结果，内部模型可以不展示。

glossary.meaning: 否决；拒绝或阻止某个系统动作
glossary.example: The driver can veto the automation before it starts.
glossary.chineseExample: 驾驶者可以在自动化开始前否决该动作。

glossary.meaning: 执行前的；发生在动作执行之前的
glossary.example: A pre-action message gives the user time to respond.
glossary.chineseExample: 执行前消息给用户回应时间。

glossary.meaning: 负担；额外的认知或操作成本
glossary.example: A long prompt can add burden during driving.
glossary.chineseExample: 长提示会在驾驶中增加负担。

glossary.meaning: 使放心；让用户确信系统仍可控
glossary.example: Manual fallback reassures the driver after a failed automation.
glossary.chineseExample: 手动回退会在自动化失败后让驾驶者放心。

glossary.meaning: 强制性的；必须接受的
glossary.example: Automation should feel helpful, not compulsory.
glossary.chineseExample: 自动化应让人感觉是帮助性的，而不是强制性的。

glossary.meaning: 隐藏了；hide 的过去式
glossary.example: The system hid its intent until the prompt appeared.
glossary.chineseExample: 系统一直隐藏意图，直到提示出现。

glossary.meaning: 降温；冷却
glossary.example: Cooling the seat can improve comfort in a hot cabin.
glossary.chineseExample: 为座椅降温可以改善炎热座舱中的舒适性。

glossary.meaning: 上升的；正在增加的
glossary.example: Rising cabin temperature can trigger a comfort suggestion.
glossary.chineseExample: 上升的座舱温度可以触发舒适建议。

glossary.meaning: 现实可行的；符合真实使用条件的
glossary.example: A realistic decision window gives the driver enough time.
glossary.chineseExample: 现实可行的决策窗口给驾驶者足够时间。

glossary.meaning: 微调；小幅修改
glossary.example: Small comfort tweaks should be easy to undo.
glossary.chineseExample: 小的舒适微调应容易撤销。

glossary.meaning: 隐含的；未直接明说但可推断的
glossary.example: Implicit consent is unsuitable for sensitive actions.
glossary.chineseExample: 默示同意不适合敏感动作。

glossary.meaning: 微调；小幅修改
glossary.example: A reversible tweak can use a lightweight prompt.
glossary.chineseExample: 可撤销微调可以使用轻量提示。

glossary.meaning: 判断；评估某事是否合适
glossary.example: The driver needs enough information to judge the automation.
glossary.chineseExample: 驾驶者需要足够信息来判断自动化。

glossary.meaning: 缺点；潜在不利影响
glossary.example: A possible downside should be visible before a route change.
glossary.chineseExample: 路线变更前应显示可能缺点。

glossary.meaning: 服从；无条件执行命令
glossary.example: Good automation is not silent obedience.
glossary.chineseExample: 好的自动化不是静默服从。

glossary.meaning: 协作；系统与用户共同完成任务
glossary.example: Visible cooperation keeps the driver involved.
glossary.chineseExample: 可见协作让驾驶者保持参与。

longReadings.title: Designing automation that drivers can stop
longReadings.text: Transparent automation in an intelligent cockpit should never feel like a hidden takeover. When the cabin assistant wants to start seat ventilation, change the route, or apply a learned climate adjustment, the interface should show the automation intent, the expected benefit, and the scope boundary before the state change happens. A short intent banner can say, "Cooling the seat soon because cabin temperature is rising," while a countdown window gives the driver a realistic chance to intervene. The veto affordance must be glance-safe: a stable cancel target, a voice veto such as "stop that," and a manual fallback if the driver gives no response. Designers also need to separate low-risk comfort tweaks from high-impact actions. Implicit consent may be acceptable for a reversible comfort tweak, but explicit consent is necessary for payment, location sharing, identity confirmation, or a route change with safety consequences. After the action, an automation receipt should explain what changed and provide an undo option. This pattern reduces automation surprise because the driver can see the trigger, judge the possible downside, and keep authority without fighting the system. Good automation is not silent obedience; it is visible cooperation.
longReadings.translation: 智能座舱中的透明自动化不应让人感觉像隐藏的接管。当座舱助手想要开启座椅通风、改变路线或应用学习到的空调调节时，界面应在状态变化发生前展示自动化意图、预期收益和范围边界。简短的意图横幅可以写“座舱温度正在上升，即将为座椅降温”，同时倒计时窗口给驾驶者真实的介入机会。否决入口必须低扫视：稳定的取消目标、“停止这个”这样的语音否决，以及用户无回应时的手动回退。设计师还需要区分低风险舒适微调和高影响动作。对于可撤销的舒适微调，默示同意也许可以接受；但支付、位置共享、身份确认或带来安全后果的路线变更需要明确同意。动作完成后，自动化回执应解释改变了什么并提供撤销选项。这种模式能减少自动化惊讶感，因为驾驶者可以看到触发条件、判断可能缺点，并在不对抗系统的情况下保持主导权。好的自动化不是静默服从，而是可见协作。

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: Transparent automation tells the driver what will change, why it will change, and how to stop it.
sentenceBreakdowns.translation: 透明自动化会告诉驾驶者什么将改变、为什么改变，以及如何停止。
points: what will change / why it will change / how to stop it 是三个并列宾语从句。
stop it 指停止当前自动化动作，而不是关闭整个系统。

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: The veto affordance must be glance-safe: a stable cancel target, a voice veto such as "stop that," and a manual fallback if the driver gives no response.
sentenceBreakdowns.translation: 否决可供性必须是低扫视的：稳定取消目标、例如“停止这个”的语音否决，以及驾驶者无回应时的手动回退。
points: glance-safe 用于说明驾驶中低视觉负荷的交互设计。
such as 引出语音命令示例；if 引导无回应条件。

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: Implicit consent may be acceptable for a reversible comfort tweak, but explicit consent is necessary for payment, location sharing, identity confirmation, or a route change with safety consequences.
sentenceBreakdowns.translation: 对于可撤销的舒适微调，默示同意也许可以接受；但支付、位置共享、身份确认或带来安全后果的路线变更需要明确同意。
points: may be acceptable 表示有条件的可接受，而不是绝对允许。
but explicit consent is necessary 强调高风险动作的确认要求。

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: Good automation is not silent obedience; it is visible cooperation.
sentenceBreakdowns.translation: 好的自动化不是静默服从，而是可见协作。
points: not A; it is B 是适合设计评审的对比句式。
visible cooperation 强调系统主动性与用户主导权的平衡。

practiceSteps.title: 词汇热身
practiceSteps.task: 朗读 transparent automation、user veto、pre-action preview、glance-safe veto，并用中文说出每个词的设计含义。

practiceSteps.title: 长文跟读
practiceSteps.task: 跟读长文两遍，重点练习 what will change, why it will change, and how to stop it 这一类三段式说明。

practiceSteps.title: 设计改写
practiceSteps.task: 把一句模糊提示改写成英文透明自动化提示，例如从 The system will optimize comfort 改成 Cooling the seat soon because cabin temperature is rising. Tap cancel to stop.

practiceSteps.title: 场景口述
practiceSteps.task: 用 4 句英文说明一个路线变更自动化：触发条件、预期收益、可能缺点、用户否决入口。

videos.title: Today's speaking focus
videos.note: 围绕 intent, boundary, veto, fallback 四个关键词进行口语复述；本课不依赖外部视频。

title: Uncertainty-aware AI recommendations in intelligent cockpits
topic: 智能座舱 AI 建议的不确定性表达与可解释交互
summary: 今天练习如何用英语说明车内 AI 助手在推荐路线、座舱模式或下一步操作时，用置信度语言、证据提示、可编辑前提和可恢复建议保护驾驶者主导权。

words.meaning: 不确定性感知建议；系统在给出建议时同时表达置信度和限制条件
words.example: An uncertainty-aware recommendation tells the driver why the assistant is not fully certain.
words.chineseExample: 不确定性感知建议会告诉驾驶者为什么助手并非完全确定。

words.meaning: 置信度语言；用 could、likely、I am not sure 等表达把握程度的措辞
words.example: Confidence language helps a cockpit assistant avoid sounding more certain than the data supports.
words.chineseExample: 置信度语言帮助座舱助手避免听起来比数据支持的程度更确定。

words.meaning: 证据提示；简短展示建议依据的数据、来源或观察结果
words.example: An evidence cue can mention traffic density, battery trend, or driver preference in one short line.
words.chineseExample: 证据提示可以用一句短话说明交通密度、电池趋势或驾驶者偏好。

words.meaning: 驾驶者确认动作；需要驾驶者明确同意后才执行的系统操作
words.example: A driver-confirmed action protects autonomy when the assistant wants to change the route or cabin mode.
words.chineseExample: 当助手想改变路线或座舱模式时，驾驶者确认动作可以保护自主权。

words.meaning: 解释深度；系统说明原因时从简短提示到详细依据的层级
words.example: Explanation depth should expand only when the driver asks for more detail.
words.chineseExample: 解释深度应只在驾驶者要求更多细节时展开。

words.meaning: 来源透明度；清楚说明建议来自传感器、地图、历史偏好还是云端服务
words.example: Source transparency lets users separate vehicle facts from learned habits.
words.chineseExample: 来源透明度让用户区分车辆事实和学习到的习惯。

words.meaning: 低置信度备用方案；当系统把握不足时采用保守、可确认的替代流程
words.example: A low-confidence fallback may ask a clarifying question instead of starting navigation automatically.
words.chineseExample: 低置信度备用方案可能会先问澄清问题，而不是自动开始导航。

words.meaning: 假设核对；在执行前确认系统推断是否符合用户真实意图
words.example: An assumption check turns a hidden inference into a quick, respectful question.
words.chineseExample: 假设核对把隐藏推断变成快速且尊重用户的问题。

words.meaning: 模型限制提示；说明 AI 可能看不到、不了解或无法保证的内容
words.example: A model limitation notice is useful when road closures or parking rules may have changed recently.
words.chineseExample: 当道路封闭或停车规则最近可能变化时，模型限制提示很有用。

words.meaning: 可恢复建议；用户拒绝、撤销或修改后仍能顺畅继续任务的建议
words.example: A recoverable suggestion lets the driver undo the assistant choice without rebuilding the whole plan.
words.chineseExample: 可恢复建议让驾驶者无需重建整个计划，也能撤销助手的选择。

glossary.chineseExample: 可恢复建议让驾驶者无需重建整个计划，也能撤销助手的选择。

glossary.meaning: 不确定性；信息不足或条件变化导致系统不能完全确认的状态
glossary.example: The cockpit interface uses uncertainty to keep the recommendation understandable.
glossary.chineseExample: 座舱界面使用“uncertainty”来让建议更容易理解。

glossary.meaning: 感知到的；意识到某个条件或限制
glossary.example: The cockpit interface uses aware to keep the recommendation understandable.
glossary.chineseExample: 座舱界面使用“aware”来让建议更容易理解。

glossary.meaning: 建议；系统提供的行动选项
glossary.example: The cockpit interface uses recommendation to keep the recommendation understandable.
glossary.chineseExample: 座舱界面使用“recommendation”来让建议更容易理解。

glossary.meaning: 置信度；系统或用户对判断可靠性的把握
glossary.example: The cockpit interface uses confidence to keep the recommendation understandable.
glossary.chineseExample: 座舱界面使用“confidence”来让建议更容易理解。

glossary.meaning: 语言；界面和语音提示中的措辞
glossary.example: The cockpit interface uses language to keep the recommendation understandable.
glossary.chineseExample: 座舱界面使用“language”来让建议更容易理解。

longReadings.title: Explaining uncertain recommendations without slowing the drive
longReadings.text: A generative cockpit assistant can make driving feel smoother, but its recommendations must not sound magical or final. When the assistant suggests a route change, a charging stop, or a quieter cabin mode, the interface should show what the system knows, what it assumes, and how confident it is. A short evidence cue, such as "traffic is building near the tunnel" or "your battery trend is lower than usual," gives the driver a reason to listen without forcing a long explanation. If the model is unsure, confidence language matters. Phrases like "this may help" or "I am not fully certain" keep trust calibrated and invite the driver to confirm the next step. Designers should also make the premise editable: the driver may prefer a scenic road, need a child-friendly stop, or know that a parking rule has changed. A good cockpit does not hide uncertainty; it turns uncertainty into a respectful choice. The safest pattern is a recoverable suggestion: explain the reason, ask before acting, and let the driver undo the assistant choice quickly. This approach keeps AI useful while preserving human agency in the cabin.
longReadings.translation: 生成式座舱助手可以让驾驶更顺畅，但它的建议不能听起来像魔法或最终决定。当助手建议改路线、增加充电停靠或切换更安静的座舱模式时，界面应展示系统知道什么、假设什么以及有多大把握。简短的证据提示，比如“隧道附近交通正在变密”或“你的电池趋势低于平常”，能给驾驶者一个愿意听取的理由，而不强迫其阅读冗长解释。如果模型不确定，置信度语言就很重要。“这可能有帮助”或“我并不完全确定”等表达能校准信任，并邀请驾驶者确认下一步。设计师还应让前提可编辑：驾驶者可能更喜欢风景道路，需要适合儿童的停靠点，或知道某条停车规则已经变化。好的座舱不会隐藏不确定性，而是把不确定性转化为尊重用户的选择。最安全的模式是可恢复建议：解释原因，执行前询问，并允许驾驶者快速撤销助手选择。这样既能保持 AI 的有用性，也能保留座舱中的人类主导权。

title: Biometric authentication and graceful lockout in intelligent cockpits
topic: 智能座舱生物识别认证与温和锁定体验
summary: 今天练习如何用英语说明智能座舱在面部、声纹或设备钥匙识别失败时，通过身份置信、权限边界、备用凭证和温和锁定体验保护隐私并保持任务可恢复。

words.meaning: 生物识别认证；通过面部、声纹、指纹等特征确认车内用户身份
words.example: Biometric authentication should unlock personal settings only after the driver understands what data is being checked.
words.chineseExample: 生物识别认证应在驾驶者理解系统正在检查哪些数据后，再解锁个人设置。

words.meaning: 温和锁定；认证失败后保持礼貌、可恢复且不制造恐慌的限制状态
words.example: A graceful lockout explains the reason for denial and offers a calm secondary path.
words.chineseExample: 温和锁定会解释拒绝原因，并提供平静的备用路径。

words.meaning: 身份置信分数；系统判断当前用户身份可靠程度的内部或可视化指标
words.example: The identity confidence score should remain hidden unless it helps the driver make a safe decision.
words.chineseExample: 身份置信分数只有在帮助驾驶者做出安全决定时才应展示。

words.meaning: 备用凭证；生物识别不可用时用于验证身份的替代方式
words.example: A fallback credential lets a passenger verify a profile without forcing repeated face scans.
words.chineseExample: 备用凭证让乘员无需反复刷脸也能验证个人档案。

words.meaning: 档案解锁边界；说明哪些个性化数据已开放、哪些仍受保护的范围
words.example: The profile unlock boundary separates comfort presets from payment or vehicle-control permissions.
words.chineseExample: 档案解锁边界区分舒适预设与支付或车辆控制权限。

words.meaning: 注册提示；引导用户录入或更新身份特征的界面提示
words.example: An enrollment prompt should say why the sample is needed and how the driver can remove it later.
words.chineseExample: 注册提示应说明为什么需要样本，以及驾驶者之后如何删除它。

words.meaning: 隐私保护匹配；尽量在本地、安全地完成身份比对的设计
words.example: A privacy-preserving match reduces the need to send sensitive cabin data to the cloud.
words.chineseExample: 隐私保护匹配减少了把敏感座舱数据发送到云端的需要。

words.meaning: 二次验证路径；当主识别失败时帮助用户继续任务的替代流程
words.example: The secondary verification path should be reachable before the user feels trapped at the start screen.
words.chineseExample: 二次验证路径应在用户觉得被困在启动界面之前就可到达。

words.meaning: 共享座舱身份冲突；多人同时在车内时系统难以判断主用户的情况
words.example: A shared-cabin identity conflict needs a neutral question instead of assuming the loudest voice owns the session.
words.chineseExample: 共享座舱身份冲突需要中性的询问，而不是默认声音最大的人拥有会话。

words.meaning: 可撤销隐私选择；用户之后可以修改、暂停或删除授权的设计
words.example: A reversible privacy choice makes biometric convenience feel less permanent and more trustworthy.
words.chineseExample: 可撤销隐私选择让生物识别便利性显得不那么永久，也更值得信任。

glossary.chineseExample: 可撤销隐私选择让生物识别便利性显得不那么永久，也更值得信任。

glossary.meaning: 访问；使用车辆功能或数据的入口
glossary.example: Basic vehicle access should remain available after biometric deletion.
glossary.chineseExample: 删除生物识别数据后，基础车辆访问仍应可用。

glossary.meaning: 有效的；处于启用状态的
glossary.example: The profile remains active until the driver locks the session.
glossary.chineseExample: 该档案会保持有效，直到驾驶者锁定会话。

glossary.meaning: 自动地；无需额外操作地
glossary.example: Comfort settings may load automatically after a confident match.
glossary.chineseExample: 在可靠匹配后，舒适设置可以自动加载。

glossary.meaning: 权限；执行高影响动作的控制权
glossary.example: Authority should be confirmed before payment or control changes.
glossary.chineseExample: 在支付或控制变更前应确认权限。

glossary.meaning: 背景语音；非目标用户或环境中的说话声
glossary.example: Background speech can reduce voice match confidence.
glossary.chineseExample: 背景语音可能降低声纹匹配置信度。

glossary.meaning: 基础车辆访问；开车门、启动车辆等最低必要能力
glossary.example: Basic vehicle access should not depend on a perfect face scan.
glossary.chineseExample: 基础车辆访问不应依赖完美的人脸扫描。

glossary.meaning: 责备；把问题归咎于用户
glossary.example: Avoid blame when recognition fails in poor lighting.
glossary.chineseExample: 在光线较差导致识别失败时要避免责备。

glossary.meaning: 座舱；车内空间
glossary.example: The cabin may contain several users with different profiles.
glossary.chineseExample: 座舱内可能有多个拥有不同档案的用户。

glossary.meaning: 平静的；不制造紧张的
glossary.example: A calm message can make lockout feel recoverable.
glossary.chineseExample: 平静的信息能让锁定显得可恢复。

glossary.meaning: 空调与温度设置
glossary.example: Climate settings can load before higher-risk permissions unlock.
glossary.chineseExample: 空调设置可以在更高风险权限解锁前加载。

glossary.meaning: 云端；远程服务器环境
glossary.example: Sensitive identity data should not be sent to the cloud unless necessary.
glossary.chineseExample: 除非必要，敏感身份数据不应发送到云端。

glossary.meaning: 舒适预设；座椅、空调等个性化配置
glossary.example: Comfort presets are lower risk than payment permissions.
glossary.chineseExample: 舒适预设的风险低于支付权限。

glossary.meaning: 置信度；系统判断可靠程度
glossary.example: Confidence may drop when lighting changes quickly.
glossary.chineseExample: 当光线快速变化时，置信度可能下降。

glossary.meaning: 确认步骤；执行前再次确认的交互环节
glossary.example: Payment requires a clearer confirmation step.
glossary.chineseExample: 支付需要更明确的确认步骤。

glossary.meaning: 控制；对功能或决策的掌控
glossary.example: Control should stay understandable during real travel.
glossary.chineseExample: 真实出行中，控制权应保持可理解。

glossary.meaning: 数据导出；把车内数据输出到外部位置
glossary.example: Data export needs stronger authentication than seat adjustment.
glossary.chineseExample: 数据导出需要比座椅调节更强的认证。

glossary.meaning: 删除；移除已保存的数据或授权
glossary.example: Deletion should not erase the user’s ability to unlock the car.
glossary.chineseExample: 删除不应抹掉用户解锁车辆的能力。

glossary.meaning: 轻松的；几乎不需要操作的
glossary.example: Biometric access can make the cockpit feel effortless.
glossary.chineseExample: 生物识别访问可以让座舱感觉很轻松。

glossary.meaning: 注册；录入身份样本的过程
glossary.example: Enrollment should explain storage and removal options.
glossary.chineseExample: 注册过程应解释存储和移除选项。

glossary.meaning: 导出动作；发送或输出数据的操作
glossary.example: Export actions should stay locked until authority is clear.
glossary.chineseExample: 在权限明确前，导出动作应保持锁定。

glossary.meaning: 人脸匹配；通过面部特征确认身份
glossary.example: A face match can unlock seat memory.
glossary.chineseExample: 人脸匹配可以解锁座椅记忆。

glossary.meaning: 家庭共享车辆
glossary.example: A family car needs clear identity switching.
glossary.chineseExample: 家庭共享车辆需要清晰的身份切换。

glossary.meaning: 脆弱的；容易出错的
glossary.example: The experience becomes fragile when recognition fails.
glossary.chineseExample: 当识别失败时，体验会变得脆弱。

glossary.meaning: 访客模式；不使用完整个人档案的临时模式
glossary.example: Guest mode helps someone drive without exposing another profile.
glossary.chineseExample: 访客模式帮助他人在不暴露他人档案的情况下用车。

glossary.meaning: 身份体验；用户被识别、授权和恢复的整体体验
glossary.example: The identity experience should be understandable during travel.
glossary.chineseExample: 身份体验在出行中应可理解。

glossary.meaning: 无效的；不被系统接受的
glossary.example: Avoid telling the user they are invalid.
glossary.chineseExample: 避免告诉用户“你无效”。

glossary.meaning: 光线；影响摄像头识别的环境条件
glossary.example: Lighting can make the face match uncertain.
glossary.chineseExample: 光线会让人脸匹配变得不确定。

glossary.meaning: 已锁定的；暂不可访问的
glossary.example: Payment permissions remain locked until verification succeeds.
glossary.chineseExample: 支付权限会保持锁定，直到验证成功。

glossary.meaning: 匹配；身份样本之间的比对结果
glossary.example: The match is uncertain when the camera view is blocked.
glossary.chineseExample: 当摄像头视野受阻时，匹配是不确定的。

glossary.meaning: 后视镜；可个性化调整的车辆部件
glossary.example: Mirrors may adjust after profile recognition.
glossary.chineseExample: 档案识别后，后视镜可以调整。

glossary.meaning: 导航历史；用户过去的路线和目的地记录
glossary.example: Navigation history is more sensitive than a seat preset.
glossary.chineseExample: 导航历史比座椅预设更敏感。

glossary.meaning: 乘员；车内人员
glossary.example: Several occupants may share the same cabin.
glossary.chineseExample: 多名乘员可能共享同一座舱。

glossary.meaning: 支付权限；允许完成车内支付的授权
glossary.example: Payment permissions require explicit confirmation.
glossary.chineseExample: 支付权限需要明确确认。

glossary.meaning: 权限；被允许访问或执行的范围
glossary.example: The cockpit must show which permissions remain locked.
glossary.chineseExample: 座舱必须显示哪些权限仍被锁定。

glossary.meaning: 手机钥匙；用手机作为车钥匙或验证凭证
glossary.example: A phone key can serve as a fallback credential.
glossary.chineseExample: 手机钥匙可以作为备用凭证。

glossary.meaning: 个人识别码；用于验证身份的数字密码
glossary.example: A PIN gives the driver a quick recovery option.
glossary.chineseExample: PIN 码为驾驶者提供快速恢复选项。

glossary.meaning: 个人档案；保存偏好和权限的用户记录
glossary.example: The active profile should be visible to the driver.
glossary.chineseExample: 当前激活的个人档案应对驾驶者可见。

glossary.meaning: 识别；系统判断用户身份的过程
glossary.example: Recognition can fail when the seating position changes.
glossary.chineseExample: 坐姿变化时识别可能失败。

glossary.meaning: 恢复路径；失败后继续完成任务的方法
glossary.example: The recovery path should be short and visible.
glossary.chineseExample: 恢复路径应简短且可见。

glossary.meaning: 样本；用于比对的生物识别数据
glossary.example: The sample should be stored with clear consent.
glossary.chineseExample: 样本应在明确同意下存储。

glossary.meaning: 座椅；常见个性化对象
glossary.example: The seat can move after a successful match.
glossary.chineseExample: 匹配成功后座椅可以移动。

glossary.meaning: 坐姿；用户在座椅中的位置和角度
glossary.example: Seating position can affect camera recognition.
glossary.chineseExample: 坐姿会影响摄像头识别。

glossary.meaning: 敏感座舱数据；可能暴露身份、位置或习惯的车内数据
glossary.example: Sensitive cabin data needs local protection.
glossary.chineseExample: 敏感座舱数据需要本地保护。

glossary.meaning: 会话；一次连续使用或登录状态
glossary.example: The session should show who is currently in control.
glossary.chineseExample: 会话应显示当前由谁控制。

glossary.meaning: 已存储的；被保存的
glossary.example: Users should know where samples are stored.
glossary.chineseExample: 用户应知道样本存储在哪里。

glossary.meaning: 临时的；非永久状态的
glossary.example: Temporary guest mode can keep the trip moving.
glossary.chineseExample: 临时访客模式可以让行程继续。

glossary.meaning: 可信设备；已绑定且可用于验证的手机或钥匙
glossary.example: A trusted device can confirm identity when face recognition fails.
glossary.chineseExample: 当人脸识别失败时，可信设备可以确认身份。

glossary.meaning: 不确定的；系统置信不足的
glossary.example: The cockpit needs another check when the match is uncertain.
glossary.chineseExample: 当匹配不确定时，座舱需要再次检查。

glossary.meaning: 可理解的；用户能明白原因和下一步的
glossary.example: Fallback choices must be understandable during real travel.
glossary.chineseExample: 回退选择在真实出行中必须可理解。

glossary.meaning: 车辆控制动作；影响车辆运行或驾驶状态的操作
glossary.example: Vehicle-control actions require a stronger authority check.
glossary.chineseExample: 车辆控制动作需要更强的权限检查。

glossary.meaning: 可见的；界面上容易发现的
glossary.example: The fallback path should be visible on the start screen.
glossary.chineseExample: 备用路径应在启动界面上可见。

glossary.meaning: 声纹匹配；通过声音确认身份
glossary.example: A voice match may fail when background speech is loud.
glossary.chineseExample: 背景语音很大时，声纹匹配可能失败。

glossary.meaning: 解锁；开放某项功能、档案或权限
glossary.example: The cockpit can unlock comfort settings after identity is confirmed.
glossary.chineseExample: 身份确认后，座舱可以解锁舒适设置。

glossary.meaning: 锁定状态；暂时阻止访问的安全状态
glossary.example: Lockout should explain the reason and provide a recovery path.
glossary.chineseExample: 锁定状态应解释原因并提供恢复路径。

glossary.meaning: 拒绝；系统不允许访问或执行请求
glossary.example: A clear denial is better than a silent failure.
glossary.chineseExample: 清楚的拒绝比无声失败更好。

glossary.meaning: 验证；确认身份或权限是否有效
glossary.example: The passenger can verify the profile with a trusted device.
glossary.chineseExample: 乘员可以用可信设备验证个人档案。

glossary.meaning: 扫描；系统采集面部、指纹或其他特征的动作
glossary.example: Repeated scans can make authentication feel stressful.
glossary.chineseExample: 反复扫描会让认证体验变得紧张。

glossary.meaning: 预设；提前保存的个性化配置
glossary.example: Presets can load after a low-risk identity match.
glossary.chineseExample: 低风险身份匹配后可以加载预设。

glossary.meaning: 车辆控制；影响车辆运行状态的功能类别
glossary.example: Vehicle-control permissions should remain locked until authority is clear.
glossary.chineseExample: 车辆控制权限应保持锁定，直到控制权明确。

glossary.meaning: 发送；把数据传到外部位置
glossary.example: The system should not send sensitive cabin data without consent.
glossary.chineseExample: 系统不应在未经同意时发送敏感座舱数据。

glossary.meaning: 被困住的；无法继续下一步的体验状态
glossary.example: A visible fallback prevents the user from feeling trapped.
glossary.chineseExample: 可见的备用路径可防止用户感到被困住。

glossary.meaning: 最大声的；声音最突出的
glossary.example: The loudest voice should not automatically own the session.
glossary.chineseExample: 最大声的人不应自动拥有会话。

glossary.meaning: 共享；多人共同使用同一车辆或空间
glossary.example: Several occupants may share the same cabin.
glossary.chineseExample: 多名乘员可能共享同一座舱。

glossary.meaning: 期待；认为某事应该发生
glossary.example: A driver may expect personal settings to appear automatically.
glossary.chineseExample: 驾驶者可能期待个人设置自动出现。

glossary.meaning: 导出；把数据输出到外部
glossary.example: Data export should require a stronger confirmation step.
glossary.chineseExample: 数据导出应需要更强的确认步骤。

glossary.meaning: 说；表达某种提示文本
glossary.example: Instead of saying the user is invalid, explain the uncertainty.
glossary.chineseExample: 与其说用户无效，不如解释不确定性。

glossary.meaning: 就座；座椅位置和乘坐状态相关的
glossary.example: Seating position may affect camera recognition.
glossary.chineseExample: 坐姿可能影响摄像头识别。

glossary.meaning: 造成；使某种状态发生
glossary.example: Background speech made the match uncertain.
glossary.chineseExample: 背景语音让匹配变得不确定。

glossary.meaning: 可信的；已经被绑定或认可的
glossary.example: A trusted device can act as a fallback credential.
glossary.chineseExample: 可信设备可以作为备用凭证。

glossary.meaning: 样本；多个用于身份比对的数据片段
glossary.example: Users should know how biometric samples are stored.
glossary.chineseExample: 用户应知道生物识别样本如何存储。

glossary.meaning: 基础的；最低必要的
glossary.example: Basic access should remain available after deletion.
glossary.chineseExample: 删除后，基础访问仍应可用。

glossary.meaning: 识别；系统确认某人或某物
glossary.example: The safest system is not always the one that recognizes everyone instantly.
glossary.chineseExample: 最安全的系统并不总是立刻识别所有人的系统。

glossary.meaning: 每个人；所有乘员或用户
glossary.example: The cockpit should not expose everyone’s profile at once.
glossary.chineseExample: 座舱不应一次暴露每个人的档案。

glossary.meaning: 立刻；马上发生
glossary.example: Instantly unlocking every feature can create privacy risk.
glossary.chineseExample: 立刻解锁所有功能可能带来隐私风险。

glossary.meaning: 出行；车辆使用过程中的真实移动场景
glossary.example: Identity choices must stay understandable during travel.
glossary.chineseExample: 身份选择在出行中必须保持可理解。

longReadings.title: Designing identity recovery for shared intelligent cockpits
longReadings.text: Biometric access can make an intelligent cockpit feel effortless, but the experience becomes fragile when recognition fails or when several occupants share the cabin. A driver may expect the seat, mirrors, navigation history, and preferred climate settings to appear automatically, yet the cockpit must still explain which profile is active and which permissions remain locked. Good authentication design separates convenience from authority. It can unlock comfort presets with a confident face or voice match, while keeping payment, vehicle-control, and data export actions behind a clearer confirmation step. When confidence is low, the interface should avoid blame. Instead of saying that the user is invalid, it can say that the cabin needs another check because lighting, seating position, or background speech made the match uncertain. The recovery path should be short, visible, and calm: use a PIN, phone key, trusted device, or temporary guest mode. Designers also need to consider enrollment and deletion. People should know where biometric samples are stored, how long they remain active, and how to remove them without losing basic vehicle access. In a shared family car, the safest identity experience is not the one that recognizes everyone instantly; it is the one that makes control, privacy, and fallback choices understandable during real travel.
longReadings.translation: 生物识别访问可以让智能座舱感觉毫不费力，但当识别失败，或多名乘员共享座舱时，体验会变得脆弱。驾驶者可能期待座椅、后视镜、导航历史和偏好的空调设置自动出现，但座舱仍必须解释当前激活的是哪个档案，以及哪些权限仍然被锁定。好的认证设计会区分便利性与控制权。它可以在面部或声纹匹配足够可靠时解锁舒适预设，同时把支付、车辆控制和数据导出动作放在更明确的确认步骤之后。当置信度较低时，界面应避免责备。与其说用户无效，不如说明因为光线、坐姿或背景语音让匹配不确定，座舱需要再次检查。恢复路径应短、可见且平静：使用 PIN、手机钥匙、可信设备或临时访客模式。设计者还需要考虑注册和删除。用户应知道生物识别样本存储在哪里、保持激活多久，以及如何在不失去基础车辆访问能力的情况下删除它们。在共享家庭车辆中，最安全的身份体验并不是立刻识别每个人，而是在真实出行中让控制、隐私和回退选择变得可理解。

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: Good authentication design separates convenience from authority.
sentenceBreakdowns.translation: 好的认证设计会区分便利性与控制权。
points: separates A from B 表示“把 A 与 B 区分开”。
convenience 指快捷、舒适的体验收益。
authority 在这里指执行高风险动作的权限。

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: When confidence is low, the interface should avoid blame.
sentenceBreakdowns.translation: 当置信度较低时，界面应避免责备。
points: when 引导条件背景。
confidence is low 指系统识别不够确定。
avoid blame 强调错误恢复文案不要指责用户。

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: The recovery path should be short, visible, and calm.
sentenceBreakdowns.translation: 恢复路径应短、可见且平静。
points: recovery path 指失败后的继续路径。
short, visible, and calm 是三个并列设计标准。
calm 表示语气和视觉状态都不制造紧张。

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: People should know where biometric samples are stored, how long they remain active, and how to remove them without losing basic vehicle access.
sentenceBreakdowns.translation: 用户应知道生物识别样本存储在哪里、保持激活多久，以及如何在不失去基础车辆访问能力的情况下删除它们。
points: where, how long, and how to 构成三个并列信息需求。
remain active 表示持续有效。
without losing basic vehicle access 说明删除授权不应切断基础用车能力。

practiceSteps.task: 朗读 10 个核心词汇，重点区分 authentication、authorization、authority 和 credential。
跟读长文一遍，标出生物识别失败后的原因解释、备用路径和隐私说明。
用英语复述一个共享家庭车场景：谁被识别、哪些权限解锁、失败后如何恢复。
改写一句锁定提示，让它同时包含低责备语气、明确原因和下一步操作。

title: Co-pilot mode awareness and driver override cues
topic: 智能座舱 AI 副驾模式感知与驾驶员覆盖提示
summary: 今天练习如何用英语说明智能座舱 AI 副驾在建议、执行、等待确认和交还责任之间切换时，通过模式提示、动作预览、覆盖入口和安全回退保持驾驶者主导权。

words.meaning: 副驾式 AI 模式感知；让用户清楚知道智能助手当前能做什么、不能做什么
words.example: Co-pilot mode awareness helps the driver know when the assistant is advising, acting, or waiting for confirmation.
words.chineseExample: 副驾式 AI 模式感知帮助驾驶者知道助手是在建议、执行，还是等待确认。

words.meaning: 驾驶员覆盖提示；提醒用户可随时接管或撤销系统动作的界面线索
words.example: A driver override cue must be visible before the cockpit changes a driving-related setting.
words.chineseExample: 在座舱改变与驾驶相关的设置前，驾驶员覆盖提示必须清晰可见。

words.meaning: 自动化边界；系统能力、权限和责任不应越过的范围
words.example: The automation boundary should be explained before the assistant starts a complex route adjustment.
words.chineseExample: 在助手开始复杂路线调整前，应解释自动化边界。

words.meaning: 意图检查点；执行关键动作前确认用户真实意图的交互节点
words.example: An intent checkpoint can prevent the AI co-pilot from accepting a vague command as final approval.
words.chineseExample: 意图检查点可以防止 AI 副驾把模糊指令当作最终批准。

words.meaning: 可恢复接管；用户接管后仍能回到先前任务状态的设计
words.example: Recoverable takeover keeps the route plan available after the driver cancels an automatic detour.
words.chineseExample: 当驾驶者取消自动绕行后，可恢复接管会保留路线方案。

words.meaning: 模式置信度指示；展示系统对当前模式判断有多确定的提示
words.example: A mode confidence indicator should stay modest when sensor evidence is incomplete.
words.chineseExample: 当传感证据不完整时，模式置信度指示应保持克制。

words.meaning: 责任交还；系统把决策或控制权明确交回驾驶者的过程
words.example: Responsibility handback needs a short reason, a safe option, and enough time for the driver to respond.
words.chineseExample: 责任交还需要简短原因、安全选项和足够响应时间。

words.meaning: AI 动作预览；在执行前展示系统将采取的具体步骤和影响
words.example: An AI action preview turns a hidden automation step into a reviewable choice.
words.chineseExample: AI 动作预览把隐藏的自动化步骤变成可审查的选择。

words.meaning: 共享权限显示；呈现人和系统各自控制范围的界面区域
words.example: The shared authority display should separate advisory control from direct vehicle control.
words.chineseExample: 共享权限显示应区分建议控制和直接车辆控制。

words.meaning: 安全回退路径；在 AI 判断不确定或用户拒绝时回到稳定状态的方法
words.example: A safe fallback path lets the cockpit return to manual guidance without losing the user goal.
words.chineseExample: 安全回退路径让座舱在不丢失用户目标的情况下回到手动引导。
